summary: T108 authoring-guide current-evidence reference repointed from T109 to T112 manifest and paired simulation-evidence; T112 added to T108 depends_on; T109 retained as historical read-only predecessor pending the SUPERSEDE amendment; T108 Must-not clauses preserved verbatim.
rationale: T112 is DELIVERED (APPROVED) and is the documented replacement for T109 as the current product-run evidence source per A0026 impact A0026:T108:authoring-guide-current-evidence. The T109 implementation wired cursor-fabricated or coverage-fabricated dataset_partition_refs, a fixed empty event source, block_range values written into tick_range fields and zero-fill run facts, so leaving T108 to keep treating T109 manifest/report/evidence as current would let the strategy authoring guide teach, validate and bind to defective evidence. T112 carries real and resolvable T100 partition references, distinct typed block_range vs tick_range fields and the fill-cursor run facts a RunState reader needs to restore position, integer inventory, equity, drawdown and T052 attribution at the actual cursor. The amendment therefore adds T112 to T108 depends_on, swaps current-evidence language in Deliverables, Replacement and migration, Acceptance and References from T109 to T112 manifest and paired simulation-evidence, and preserves T109 only as a historical read-only predecessor pending the SUPERSEDE amendment. All Must-not clauses are preserved verbatim with no weakening; no safety, execution, signer, risk, registry authority or product-module clause changes.

impact_assessment.intent: Not applicable. PROJECT_GOALS.md is not edited and the G-STRATEGY-REGISTRY-01 intent, the strategy identity authority and the GUIDE-AS-NON-AUTHORITY intent keep their existing meaning. T108 still requires the authoring guide to teach registered identity, schema, version, code provenance and a registry-bound manifest through the current authority.
impact_assessment.specification: Not applicable. T108 references docs/spec/strategy/STRATEGY_ECONOMICS.md section 7 and ADR-006; none of these documents are edited by this amendment. A0026 already aligned the relevant spec documents (THREAT_MODEL.md T-21/T-22, DATASET_AND_EVALUATION.md DS-005/DS-006/DS-007) with the T112 evidence model.
impact_assessment.contracts: T108 is the only contract edited. Its Dependencies gain T112 alongside the existing T067, T068 and T109 edges; its Deliverables retarget the registry-bound manifest and publication-boundary language from T109 to T112 manifest and paired simulation-evidence; its Replacement and migration retargets the validate-through clause from T068/T109 to T068/T112; its Acceptance retargets the current-sources citation from T068/T109 to T068/T112; and its References adds T112 as the current registry-bound source for manifest and paired simulation-evidence while keeping T109 as the historical predecessor with T105 noted as predecessor history. The T108 Must-not block is preserved verbatim with no weakening. T073, T084, T107, T110, T111, T085, T086, T087, T088, T103 and T096 contracts are not in this amendment's target set and remain PLANNED with their existing contract text; they are expected to be amended in their own Owner-directed amendments.
impact_assessment.dependencies: T108 depends_on in todo/config.yaml is extended from `T067, T068, T109` to `T067, T068, T109, T112`. T112 is now a hard dependency for the strategy authoring guide contract; the retained T109 edge remains the historical read-only path. No other task's depends_on is touched. Downstream dependents of T108 (T096 only) inherit the new evidence reference through the existing T108 edge and need no contract edits in this amendment. T067's `superseded_by T108` annotation, T108's `replaces T067` annotation, T108's lifecycle, attempt, base_commit, candidate_commit, approved_commit, latest_review, claimed and task_file fields are unchanged; workflow_state, active_task, active_phase, intent_revision, spec_revision and agent_runtime are unchanged.
impact_assessment.implementation: Not applicable in this amendment. No business code is authored or changed. When T108 is later implemented, the authoring guide and example will reference T112 manifest and paired simulation-evidence per the updated contract. The T109 contract's defective fixed-empty-source and fabricated-reference writer remain non-current for new runs under T112's runtime cutover clause; the strategy authoring guide remains outside `src/robinhood_lp/` with no network or execution authority.
impact_assessment.data: Not applicable. Existing T109 manifests, reports and simulation-evidence, pre-T112 T109 records, T105/T069/T063 history, candidate locks, prior guide/example/review artifacts and any prior authoring evidence stay byte-identical and read-only through the versioned legacy reader. New guide/example/drift-test content authored after this amendment will reference T112 manifest and paired simulation-evidence, but no T108 authoritative artifact is rewritten under this amendment.
impact_assessment.operations: Not applicable in this amendment. T112's runtime cutover remains gated by T112's atomic-publication clause, and until the reviewed SUPERSEDE amendment annotates T109 superseded_by T112, the cutover boundary keeps new successful production publication disabled. The authoring guide is documentation-only and the runtime cutover/fail-closed behaviour of the registered example continues to refuse a free-text fallback.
impact_assessment.security: Not applicable. The authoring guide grants no signer, paper-live promotion, execution, risk or registry authority; the Security clause in Replacement and migration retains the ban on network reads, dependencies, credentials, .env values, key material and execution authority. T112 evidence carries no private key, signing payload, endpoint secret, webhook credential, .env value, RPC URL or authorization header by contract.
impact_assessment.verification: T108 acceptance retains its existing positive and negative tests and now binds the citation check and the validate-through check to T112 manifest and paired simulation-evidence; the must-not evidence (no second authority, no uncited rule, no product module, no third-party dependency, no engine or Spec change, no profitable/approved/live presentation, no notes-as-identity, no inferred registry entry, no author-controlled ledger/evidence order, no duplicated canonical market input, no strategy-callback replay, no post-sorted non-causal evidence, no CI weakening, no historical manifest/evidence rewriting, no registration/publication/execution/promotion authority grant) is preserved verbatim. The old-path-unreachable checks over current guide links, commands and T105 publisher semantics remain in force. T108 itself does not re-test the T112 pipeline-repair invariants (real T100 partition resolution, block_range vs tick_range separation, fill-cursor preservation); those are exercised by T112's own acceptance matrix.
